description: Send privacy-bounded Codex prompt/final history to Windows Terminal with durable retry.

hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$repo = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1); $script = if ($repo) { Join-Path $repo '.codex/hooks/workspace-history.ps1' }; if ($script -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script)) { & $script -EventName 'UserPromptSubmit' }"

pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "[Console]::Out.WriteLine('{}'); [Console]::Out.Flush(); $repo = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1); $script = if ($repo) { Join-Path $repo '.codex/hooks/workspace-history.ps1' }; if ($script -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script)) { & $script -EventName 'Stop' -SuppressStopResponse }"

pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$repo = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1); $script = if ($repo) { Join-Path $repo '.codex/hooks/workspace-history.ps1' }; if ($script -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script)) { & $script -EventName 'SessionStart' }"
